operations.title: Entry 1215 — The Physical Five-Site Loop Locus Is a Rank-Three Determinantal Complete Intersection
operations.summary: On any nonsingular labelled 3x3 external Gram pivot H, the physical d=3 five-edge loop locus is cut out by L=v4-c^T u and Q=det(H)Y1^2-u^T adj(H)u. Their Jacobian in (v4,Y1^2) is det(H), and all 25 four-by-four Gram minors vanish. The five labelled edge variables reduce regularly to three physical variables on existing Gram determinantal support.

operations.title: Benincasa derives the physical d=3 five-site determinantal locus
operations.body: Entry 1215 repairs the missing physical support. On a labelled nonsingular 3x3 external Gram pivot H, d=3 imposes L=v4-c^T u=0 and Q=det(H)Y1^2-u^T adj(H)u=0. Symbolica verifies all 25 four-by-four minors vanish; det d(L,Q)/d(v4,Y1^2)=det(H), so this is a regular codim-2 complete intersection leaving exactly three loop variables. Pivot changes are invertible presentations of the intrinsic rank<=3 determinantal ideal. No new carrier support. Next is the coarea/Poincare-residue current along (L,Q).
